Dear Sir/Madam,

Jai Jinendra!

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to respectfully follow up on my earlier communication regarding HeatBolt and the opportunity to explore a potential association with your esteemed organization.

Over the past few weeks, we have made encouraging progress across multiple fronts:
- Government Engagement: Successfully concluded high-level meetings with the Ministries of Defence, Home Affairs, Railways, and other key stakeholders, alongside subsequent engagement with the PMO office.
- Global Industry Interest: Advancing discussions with leading international organizations, including Nestlé, Barilla Group, Mondelēz, and Godrej.
- Market Opportunity: More than 60,000 stakeholder engagements, 1,000+ daily inbound enquiries, and commercial assessments indicating substantial annual manufacturing potential.
- Technology Platform: Developing HeatBolt as an integrated portable thermal infrastructure and self-heating packaging ecosystem, with applications across food, beverages, defence, emergency response, healthcare, and other sectors.

Our Intent to Build Together
We are not simply looking for financial support; we are looking to build a meaningful, long-term relationship with the right strategic organization.

We would genuinely value the opportunity to work closely with your leadership team, combining your organization's experience, industry network, and execution capabilities with HeatBolt's technology and innovation platform.

We are open to exploring strategic investment, manufacturing collaboration, commercialization, technology licensing, and broader business partnerships.

I would be grateful for an opportunity to personally present our progress, business roadmap, and potential areas of collaboration in a brief 15–20-minute meeting.

We sincerely believe that the right partnership at this stage could create something transformative, both commercially and globally.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

Dr. Kumarpal Porwal
Founder & CEO | HeatBolt
+91 73533 19757 | +91 88672 94189 (WhatsApp Preferred)
